name: attendance-management-system-root
description: Root workspace runner for Attendance Management System (MERN Stack)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});"
